title: Heat Pump Water Heaters: What to Know and What They Pay
desc: What a heat pump water heater is, what to check before you buy, and every open water heater rebate we track, with the official page and date.
lead: A heat pump water heater heats your water with the same idea as a heat pump. Here is what to check, and what pays today.
image_alt: A single-story duplex house with a front porch
intro:
A heat pump water heater pulls heat from the air around it and uses it to heat water. That takes much less electricity than a regular electric tank.

Programs pay for specific models, and some only pay when you replace an electric or gas tank. Space matters too, because the unit needs room and air around it. Ask your installer where it will go, and check the program page for the list of eligible models.
checks: Is the model on the list? Rebates are for certain models.
What you are replacing. Some programs pay only for replacing an electric tank. Others also cover gas.
Where it goes. The unit needs space and airflow. A closet or a cold basement may not work.
Other measures. Some programs pay only when you do a second upgrade at the same time.
The installer. Many programs need a licensed or trained company.
faq: Is a heat pump water heater loud?
Models differ. Ask for the sound rating, and ask where the unit will be installed.
Can I use one in a condo?
Some programs exclude condos and apartments. Check the official page for your home type.
How is it different from a regular tank?
It heats water with warm air from the room rather than only with an electric element.
